units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 9:30">Targ. II Kings IX, 30</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 80a:7">Sabb. 80ᵃ</cite> <he>עין … הא לא כַחֲלֵי</he> but people never paint one eye only!

<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:12">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>חברוהי כַחְלִינְהוּ וכ׳</he> his associates put his eyes out, v. <cite ref="K00048"><he>כְּבִי</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:2:3">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᵈ</cite> top <he>כחל לה</he>, read in one w., v. <cite ref="H01079"><he>חֲלָלָא</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Niddah 55b">Nidd. 55ᵇ</cite> if one desires to become blind, <he>לִיכְּחוֹל מארמאי</he> (<he>מעכ״ום</he>) let him have his eyes painted by gentiles; Y. Ab. Zar. l. c. <he>מִיכְּחוּל מינהון</he>.
